defaults.motion_elements: the string lights and the falling snow
defaults.ambient: Snow falls gently over the rows of pines.

shots.subject: Long rows of snowy young fir trees on a gentle hillside, a big red barn at the top with warm string lights along its roofline and a wreath on its doors, the low sun behind the barn
A vintage farm truck with rounded fenders parked beside the fir rows, a freshly cut fir tied on its back, warm string lights draped along the truck bed and snow on the hood
A small wooden hut selling trees at the farm entrance, a counter with a glowing lantern, its roof edged with warm bulbs and pine garland, cut trees leaning in rows beside it
A snowy tree-farm path between tall rows of firs lined with lanterns on short wooden posts, strings of warm lights draped from post to post, the path leading toward a red barn
shots.motion_elements: the lanterns, the string lights and the falling snow

shots.subject: Bundled fir trees wrapped in twine leaning against a snowy split-rail fence, warm string lights along the top rail and the sunlit snowy field behind
shots.focus: the bundled trees on the fence

shots.subject: A wide snowy farm field at golden hour with scattered firs of every size, a lone lit Christmas tree on a small rise and a farmhouse with glowing windows in the distance
shots.focus: the lone lit tree on the rise

shots.subject: An old red tractor pulling a flat hay wagon loaded with hay bales and cut firs, warm string lights along the wagon rails, stopped on a snowy farm lane between the fir rows
shots.focus: the tractor and the hay wagon

shots.subject: Close view of a freshly cut fir lying on the snow beside its stump, a wooden bow saw and a coil of twine next to it, warm fairy lights glowing on the nearby branches
A red barn with a large lit wreath above its open doors, the barn interior glowing warm with hanging bulbs and stacked trees, snowy fir rows in the foreground
A tree-baling station under a wooden roof, a fir being pulled through a big funnel into white netting, netted trees stacked around it and warm bulbs strung overhead
shots.focus: the netted trees under the lights

shots.subject: Rolling snowy hills covered in neat rows of firs, a winding farm lane with lantern posts and a little white farmhouse with red trim glowing warm
Close view of snowy fir branches tied with plain red ribbons, warm fairy lights wound through the needles and a soft golden sun flare behind
shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights, the ribbon ends and the falling snow

shots.subject: A small wooden cider stand at the farm with a steaming pot on a burner, stacked mugs and warm bulbs along its awning, snowy fir rows behind
shots.motion_elements: the steam, the string lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Steam rises from the cider pot. Snow falls gently.

shots.subject: The tree farm at blue hour after sunset, the red barn and the sales hut lit with warm string lights, rows of firs dark blue in the snow
A rustic wooden sled loaded with a small cut fir and a wreath, parked in the snow between fir rows, warm string lights on the nearest trees
A tall windbreak of mature spruces along the edge of the farm, their lower branches wrapped in warm lights, young fir rows in the foreground and a golden sky behind
Close view of a stack of fresh pine wreaths with red bows hanging on a weathered barn wall, warm string lights along the wall and snow settling on the wreaths
shots.focus: the wreaths on the barn wall

shots.subject: A snowy tree-farm yard with a stone fire pit burning, log benches around it, warm bulbs strung between tall poles and a cut tree leaning on a post
shots.motion_elements: the fire pit flames, the string lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls gently. The fire pit flames flicker.

shots.subject: A tree farm in a snowy valley seen from a hilltop, a patchwork of fir plantations, a red barn and a lit farm lane, the golden sun low over the far hills
shots.focus: the red barn in the valley

shots.subject: Close view of a row of small potted firs in burlap sacks on a wooden table under warm bulbs, snow dusting their tips
